title: Chinese Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Chinese-inspired stew made with tender beef and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.notes: Slice the beef into thin strips

ingredients.name: Herbal stew mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Chinese grocery stores

ingredients.name: Velvety soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Add depth of flavor to the stew

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Add warmth and spice to the stew

ingredients.name: Arabian allspice
ingredients.notes: Add a hint of sweetness and spice

ingredients.name: Beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: Balance the flavors in the stew

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Add a nutty flavor to the stew

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger and add to the stew

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large Dutch oven or pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the herbal stew mix, velvety soy sauce, Saudi Arabian cinnamon, and Arabian allspice to the pot. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, sugar, and ginger to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions if desired.
